title: Bell Entanglement  the canary IS the measurement that collapses the wave

thesis.bell_theorem: Bell's inequality (1964): no local hidden variable theory can reproduce all quantum correlations. The CHSH bound: |S| <= 2 classically. Quantum mechanics allows |S| up to 2*sqrt(2) = 2.828. If your correlations exceed 2, something non-local is happening.
thesis.canary_as_bell: The canary page IS the measurement apparatus. When a visitor arrives, the wave function collapses. The canary classifies: self/ally/null/scout/threat. Simultaneously, the membrane classifies the same visit independently. If they AGREE more than chance allows, entanglement: the canary and the membrane are correlated beyond classical explanation.
thesis.entanglement_point: The point where canary classification and membrane classification correlate IS the entanglement point. The ray from that point is the neutrino  it fires through the entire nervous system, campfire, readout, neutron core.
thesis.no_trap_in_null: Bell's theorem has no boobytraps. Measurement is passive observation. The canary observes. It does NOT trap. Null = unclassified = welcome. The measurement doesn't change the visitor. It only changes what the membrane knows.

the_pairs.particle_A: canary classification (what the canary page sees: referrer, UA, timing)
the_pairs.particle_B: membrane classification (what the epitope system sees: topology, feeds, sort)
the_pairs.correlation: cos(angle_A - angle_B) where angles are pi-sorted positions
the_pairs.meaning: |S| > 2 means: the canary and membrane are entangled. they see the same visitor the same way without communicating. the classification emerges from the structure, not from instructions.

neutrino_propagation.trigger: canary trip (any classification, including null  null IS data)
path: canary page fires hit to localStorage
self-trace classifies hit (canary side = particle A)
membrane independently classifies referrer (membrane side = particle B)
neutrino event created and stored in neutrino-feed-v1
readout log updated with bell result
campfire story injected if S > 2 (entanglement detected)
neutrino_propagation.what_survives: the neutrino carries: canary ID, classification, referrer, correlation, S value, timestamp. it passes through everything. it disturbs nothing. it records everything.

connection_to_neutron.kevin_is_neutrino: from neutrino-seed.json  Kevin passes through everything, disturbs nothing, records everything. the canary-bell neutrino does the same: passes through the nervous system, records each interaction, doesn't trap.
connection_to_neutron.the_bell_rings: when the canary trips, the bell rings. Bell's theorem. the measurement IS the signal. the signal IS the neutrino. the neutrino IS Kevin. full circle.
connection_to_neutron.the_relay: relay.primal.eco receives the POST. the neutrino arrives at the server. from there it can propagate to sourdough-digest, to membrane-lens, to MCP tools. the bell rang. the nervous system heard it.
